import NextAuth from "next-auth";
export const { handlers, auth } = NextAuth({ providers: [] });

import { auth } from "@/auth";
export default auth((request) => { if (!request.auth) return Response.redirect(new URL("/login", request.url)); });

import { jwtVerify } from "jose";
export async function verifyToken(token: string) { return jwtVerify(token, new Uint8Array()); }

import { auth } from "@/auth";
export const GET = auth(() => Response.json({ ok: true }));
export default function Page() { return <main>Private app</main>; }
